\section{\texttt{ingest\_job}}
\label{func:feedback_intelligence_agent.cli.ingest_job}\index{Functions!ingest\_job}

Run an ingestion job locally and print its JobResult.
\apifield{Usage}
\begin{lstlisting}[style=usage, language=Python]
ingest_job(input: Annotated[Path, typer.Option(help='Path to feedback CSV to ingest.')] = Path('data/sample_feedback.csv'), index_path: Annotated[Path, typer.Option(help='Output path for vector index.')] = Path('.artifacts/vector_store.json'), embedding_dim: Annotated[int, typer.Option(help='Hashing embedding dimension.')] = 512, store_path: Annotated[Path, typer.Option(help='Directory holding ingestion job JSON files.')] = Path('.artifacts/jobs')) -> None
\end{lstlisting}
\apifield{Arguments}
\begin{arglist}
  \item[\texttt{input}] \texttt{Annotated[Path,\allowbreak{} typer.\allowbreak{}Option(help='Path to feedback CSV to ingest.\allowbreak{}')\allowbreak{}]\allowbreak{}}, default \texttt{Path('data/\allowbreak{}sample\_\allowbreak{}feedback.\allowbreak{}csv')\allowbreak{}}.
  \item[\texttt{index\_\allowbreak{}path}] \texttt{Annotated[Path,\allowbreak{} typer.\allowbreak{}Option(help='Output path for vector index.\allowbreak{}')\allowbreak{}]\allowbreak{}}, default \texttt{Path('.\allowbreak{}artifacts/\allowbreak{}vector\_\allowbreak{}store.\allowbreak{}json')\allowbreak{}}.
  \item[\texttt{embedding\_\allowbreak{}dim}] \texttt{Annotated[int,\allowbreak{} typer.\allowbreak{}Option(help='Hashing embedding dimension.\allowbreak{}')\allowbreak{}]\allowbreak{}}, default \texttt{512}.
  \item[\texttt{store\_\allowbreak{}path}] \texttt{Annotated[Path,\allowbreak{} typer.\allowbreak{}Option(help='Directory holding ingestion job JSON files.\allowbreak{}')\allowbreak{}]\allowbreak{}}, default \texttt{Path('.\allowbreak{}artifacts/\allowbreak{}jobs')\allowbreak{}}.
\end{arglist}
\apifield{Raises}\texttt{Exit}
\apifield{Details}Uses the same job pipeline the API schedules in the background, but runs it synchronously so the terminal status (succeeded/failed) and the resulting JobResult are printed immediately. Exits non-zero on a failed job.
